blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The City of Manila recorded 32 new influenza-like illness (ILI) cases on Monday, the highest number of new cases among the illnesses included in the city’s latest W.I.L.D. diseases report covering water-borne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis and dengue. The Manila Health Department (MHD) also logged 22 new dengue cases, 15 new leptospirosis cases and one new confirmed COVID-19 case on Sept. 21. The latest figures were based on data extracted from the Electronic Disease Case Surveillance and Information System (EDCS-IS) as of 7 a.m. Monday.
